messages:
Anika: Heads-up — I'm about to hand the twilight standby to Liam in ~8m. I'm still primary for the embeddings stack but Nora (secondary) is on a delayed flight. Leaving a small playbook and open questions. pls ack. :wave:
Liam: Ack. I can take it but FYI I have a calendar block at 23:30 for a deploy window. If anything noisy starts we should either pause or push it.
Anika: Agree. Deploy is scheduled but non-breaking; still, if pages spike please pause the rollout. Key things: current pager policy routes to primary -> secondary -> eng-lead. Nora is reachable but might be slow to respond.
ops-bot: Reminder: standing handoff requires runbook link + pager re-route confirmation. Use `ops-bot handoff --claim @Liam --shift twilight` to record.
Liam: Done. ran `ops-bot handoff --claim @Liam --shift twilight` — confirmation posted. I set my phone to Do Not Disturb exceptions for Pager.
Anika: Leaving quick runbook snippet below (copy/paste into incident channel if needed):
```
Runbook: embeddings_high_error_rate
- Check fronting router: `kubectl -n prod get deploy embed-router`
- Get recent 5xx: `kubectl -n prod logs --since=10m deploy/embed-router | grep 5..`
- If >5% 5xx: flip traffic to `embed-fallback` via `/infra/traffic switch embed -> embed-fallback`
- If repeats: escalate to eng-lead after 2 pages within 15m
```
Nora: I'm online and reachable via phone but ETA to hotel ~35m. If you end up doing a long-blocking mitigation, @Rao can take over secondary.
Rao: I can be secondary if Nora is offline. Quick ask: what are the precise SLOs for this window?
Anika: SLOs: 99.5% uptime for embed requests, p95 latency <120ms. Customers impacted flagged are internal search + recs. If more than 1 customer ticket opens, flag PG.
Devon: small note — embedding model will auto-scale but the autoscaler threshold is 80% CPU; we've seen noisy scaling thrash if traffic is flipped abruptly. Prefer gradual traffic shift with 10% steps / 1m between.
Liam: Noted. I'll do stepped failover if needed. Also adding a temporary watchrule: if 5xx rate > 4% for 5m, page primary immediately.
incident-bot: ALERT: embed-router 5xx rate 3.8% last 2m — watchlist. Link: https://monitoring.redwood/in/alerts/embeds-5xx
Anika: Good catch. Liam, if that goes north of 5% -> execute the runbook flip (gradual). I'll stay reachable for the next 45m in case things get hairy.
Liam: Copy. I'm patching the canary watch to 2m and adding a short alert mute for non-actionable flaps during deploy. Will post a final "handoff complete" when Nora confirms or Rao is in place.
Nora: Hotel wifi is flaky but I confirmed I can take full secondary at +40m if needed.
Liam: Handoff complete for twilight. I'm now primary. Leaving this thread pinned to the channel for anyone who joins. :pushpin:
Anika: Thanks — leaving notes in the shift log. If pages escalate, mention `@eng-rotation` so we pull extra eyes.
Rao: Thanks team — I'll stay on standby in case Nora drops off.
ops-bot: Handoff recorded: primary=@Liam, secondary=@Nora (backup=@Rao). Shift window: 23:00-07:00. Reference runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embeds/high-5xx
Liam: (final) If anybody sees noisy 502/503 stanzas, call out "embed-failover" in the incident title. OK to close this thread once the deploy finishes and the watch stabilizes.
